summary: Accumulates bits into the bitstream shift register this+0x16AB: ORs (a3 << bitCount) and raises bitCount at this+0x16AD by 3. When bitCount exceeds 13, flushes the two-byte register to the output buffer (base this+0x8, offset this+0x14), advances the offset by 2, decrements bitCount by 13, and re-anchors the register to (uint16)a3 >> (16 - oldBitCount). Always calls ChecksummedBufferWriter(a2, 1) and returns its result.

local_names.a2: writer/checksum context argument forwarded to ChecksummedBufferWriter

operations.description: Read bitCount at this+0x16AD; if bitCount <= 13 accumulate, else flush the two-byte register.
Accumulate path: bitCount this+0x16AD becomes bitCount + 3 and this+0x16AB is OR-ed with (a3 << bitCount).

Flush path: write low byte of this+0x16AB to buffer[base + offset] and high byte (this+0x16AC) to buffer[base + offset + 1] using base this+0x8 and offset this+0x14; advance offset by 2; bitCount -= 13; shift register this+0x16AB becomes (uint16)a3 >> (16 - oldBitCount).
Call ChecksummedBufferWriter(a2, 1) for output/checksum tracking; return value is the function result.

unresolved: The meaning of the +3 accumulation step and the 13-bit flush threshold (whether the unit is 3 bits per call) is derived from source patterns and existing analysis prose, not named in evidence.
